2M likes, 6,024 comments - itsmarziapie on December 25, 2024: "Merry Christmas! 🎄 💫 
We spent a cosy Christmas Eve at home - Santa made an appearance bringing gifts, and Björn was very confused 😅 but he had such a fun time watching a bit of Kalle Anka to keep up with the Swedish tradition. We made sure to drink 100% original Julmust, and of course, Björn also had his first slice of Pandoro today. 🇮🇹 ⭐️ Oh, and yes you are not seeing double: we adopted a new pug from a shelter - everybody, please welcome Mochi! 🐶".
